introHtml: ML Kishigo specializes in high-visibility safety outerwear built for demanding work environments. Their ANSI-compliant vests, jackets, and parkas combine durable fabrics with reflective trim, making them a reliable choice for construction crews, road crews, and warehouse teams. When you order custom ML Kishigo outerwear, you get gear that keeps your team visible and your brand front and center, whether you choose screen-printed logos or embroidered names on the chest.
